label: 📑 Excel
description: Read and write Microsoft Excel workbooks. Reads both .xlsx (modern) and .xls (legacy binary) via the Rust calamine engine. Writes .xlsx only. Auto-detects whether the first row is a header.

header.label: Header row
header.help: auto: heuristically detect (data-like row 0 → no header). yes/no: force the choice. When no header, columns are named col_1, col_2, …

island_range.label: Cell range (Excel A1)
island_range.help: Optional. When set (e.g. 'B2:F50'), reads only that rectangle from the sheet. Used by the data-island picker to scope ingest to one of multiple disjoint tables on the same sheet. Leave blank to read the whole sheet.
